items.statement: Demerger transfer caused sharp decline in cash levels during FY26
items.quote: Demerger transfer was there.

items.statement: Working capital limits available and collections from EBOs expected to manage cash flow in FY27
items.quote: No, we have working capital, but we have not utilized the total limit. So we have our limit available. So hope with the collection coming in from our EBOs, we will be able to manage the cash flow situation also.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents rose to Rs. 328 lakhs from Rs. 168 lakhs last year.
items.quote: As we can see, by the end of it, the cash and cash equivalents were a healthy number of Rs. 328 lakhs vis-à-vis Rs. 168 lakhs last year.

items.statement: Total liabilities fell sharply from Rs. 50 crores to Rs. 12.20 crores, a reduction of close to 75%.
items.quote: Our total liabilities in this period fell sharply from Rs. 50 crores to 12.20 crores. So, reduction of close to 75%.

items.statement: Trade payables reduced from Rs. 30.21 crores to Rs. 3.77 crores.
items.quote: We reduced our trade payables from 30.21 crores to 3.77 crores.

items.statement: Debt reduced by 40%.
items.quote: We reduce our debt by 40%.

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative due to changes in working capital including inventory, trade receivables, provisions and trade payables
items.quote: Sir, the major reason for the negative working operations cash flow from operations that there are some major changes in working capital, some part in inventory, some part in trade receivables, and provisions as well as the trade payables.

items.statement: Advances from customers are INR 9.74 crores out of INR 10.8 crores other current liabilities
items.quote: It is INR 9.74 crores.

items.statement: Company expects operating cash flow to turn positive in FY27
items.quote: So only that reason the operation cash flow from operations are negative, but overall cash flow the company is with healthy cash reserves. So, I think in the next year we can say that the operations cash flow from operations will be positive side.

items.statement: IPO raised around 60 Cr on 25th March 2026; no proceeds used in previous year
items.quote: In 2026, we achieved a milestone where we launched an IPO, which was able to raise a total issue size of around 60 Cr.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of around 60 Cr available; plan to use 11-12 Cr for business expansion, 10-12 Cr for product development, 12 Cr for acquisitions
items.quote: So, the plan is to use that money for both. Inorganic and organic growth. Aman Kamdar: Okay, so we'll acquire… Deepak Tomar: Three major elements where we're gonna invest are the acquisition, sales, marketing, and product development

items.statement: Management plans to raise equity in the second half of FY27, noting they have raised equity every year for the last seven years.
items.quote: The history tells us that in the last 7 years, every single year we have raised some amount of equity. So I think this year will not be any exception, but let's see. I mean, in terms of availability of equity, it is there. Let's see how things shape up. I mean market scenario needs to improve because of this war and all. So definitely, on our side, we will target to raise some equity in the second

items.statement: Operating cash flow for FY26 was positive Rs. 10.92 crores, reflecting underlying cash generation capacity of capsules business.
items.quote: Operating cash flow for the year was a positive Rs. 10.92 crores, which reflects the underlying cash generation capacity of the capsules business and provides us with a reasonable working capital base to operate from.

items.statement: Company applied for government RDI scheme funding from BIRAC; may do preferential allotment with promoter participation or rights issue, but promoter group does not want to dilute much.
items.quote: We have also made an application under government RDI scheme to BIRAC, and | am hopeful that we might get some funding as being a deep tech company here in pharma AP! line. We expect to contribute equal amount from our side which should be in form of equity. We might do a kind of preferential allotment where the promoters could also participate, and we could also do a right issue

items.statement: Inventory nearly doubled to Rs 18 crore due to 25-30% of output requiring manual re-processing at labour homes, creating dead stock.
items.quote: So because we have expanded our facility, so the production got increased and in cashew generally we have one big challenge that almost 30% of our inventory which required manual intervention.

items.statement: Borrowings jumped from Rs 5 crore to over Rs 10 crore to fund working capital needs driven by rising raw material prices and higher production volumes.
items.quote: So our borrowings also have jumped from nearly 5 crores last year to over 10 Cr now.

items.statement: Debtor days improved from 163 to 114 days and trade receivables declined to ~63 crore despite higher volumes
items.quote: debtors improved substantially from 163 days to 114 days. Trade receivable declined to approximately 63 crore despite of higher business volume, reflecting stronger cash conversion and tighter working capital control.

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved meaningfully by 44% with disciplined inventory management
items.quote: Our working capital cycle improved meaningfully by 44%. Inventory management remained disciplined and we continued building a scalable platform that supports both growth, domestic gr owth and export

items.statement: All outstanding warrants held by promoter group have been converted
items.quote: The warrants have been converted, all of them. The last warrant that was remaining with the promoter group has been converted.

items.statement: Positive operating cash flow of Rs.6.1 Crores generated in FY2026 versus negative in FY2025
items.quote: Another major milestone during FY2026 was generation of positive operating cash flow of approximately Rs.6.1 Crores compared to negative operating cash flow in FY2025.

items.statement: Cash equivalents increased to approximately Rs.3.5 Crores in FY2026
items.quote: The balance sheet also strengthened during the year, cash equivalent increased to approximately Rs.3.5 Crores, while net worth increased to approximately Rs.199 Crores despite continued investment in growth initiatives.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased during FY2026 as healthcare platform scaled
items.quote: Trade receivable increased during the year as healthcare platform continued to scale, while healthcare receivables are naturally influenced by TPA and institutional settlement cycles.

items.statement: Entire growth and capex funded through internal accruals with credit rating intact
items.quote: No external capital has been raised during the financial year from any financial institution or in form of equity for this entire capex as well as the growth in the top line. Entire growth and capex has been funded through internal accruals.

items.statement: Promoter group held 74.98% shareholding as of March 31, 2026; CEO increased personal stake from 39.8% to 40.4% via open market purchases in FY26.
items.quote: As of March 31, 2026, the promoter group held 74.98% shareholding in the company. During financial year '26, I increased my personal shareholding from 39.8% to 40.4% through open market purchases.

items.statement: Operating cash generation was INR17.29 crores in FY26; cash and bank balances stood at INR88.62 crores; trade receivables were INR10.23 crores.
items.quote: Operating cash generation remained healthy at INR17.29 crores during financial year 26. Cash and bank balances at the year-end stood at INR88.62 crores, while current investments increased to INR81.13 crores. Trade receivables remained well -controlled at INR10.23 crores, reflecting disciplined collection and healthy client payment profile.

items.statement: Promoter will exercise warrants and add equity now that IPO lock-in and financial results announcement restrictions are lifted
items.quote: I'll be executing the warrants very soon. There was a lock in on for me to buy any shares through the warrant instrument, because of the lock in for the IPO and the financial results announcement.

items.statement: Company holds INR 20-25 crores cash; operating cash flow negative due to working capital investment for growth; expects positive operating cash flow in 2-3 years
items.quote: we are sitting on a very good liquidity wherein we have approximately INR 20-25 crores of cash. And for future also, fundraising will -- if we have a good headroom there in terms of raising debt as well

items.statement: Operating cash flow negative because of working capital expansion; can turn positive if growth paused but focus remains on scaling
items.quote: if we were to decide, today that we want to pause the growth and maintain this scale, we can do that and turn the cash flows positive, right? But that's not the focus, I would say.

items.statement: Management states no equity dilution needed to reach 1,000 crore AUM, will use NCDs and term loans instead.
items.quote: Till 1,000 crores of AUM, we do not need any further equity dilution. With the use of NCDs and term loans, that is why we have debt, we wil l be able to reach an AUM of 1,000 crores in near future without diluting equity.

items.statement: Inflame incorporated associate company Tricoree Machmatrix Private Limited with 34% stake for electronics, IoT-enabled products, smart control solutions and backward integration
items.quote: We have also incorporated another associate company by the name of Tricoree Machmatrix Private Limited. Inflame has a 34% stake in it.

items.statement: Promoters may consider raising stake after Diwali but possibility is less in short run
items.quote: We will consider doing it, sir. But right now, in the short run, the possibility is less. But probably after Diwali, we might think of it.

items.statement: Runway available for close to 10 to 12 months
items.quote: So right now, runway is available for close to about 10 to 12 months.

items.statement: Receivables grew from INR119 crore to INR124 crore in H2 FY26 due to collection issues on four contracts; most cleared in April, bringing debtors down to INR120 crore.
items.quote: in the second half of the year it has grown from INR119 crores to INR124 crore. The reason for that increase in INR5 crore s is because we kind of suffered colle ction issues with four contracts

items.statement: Aging shows more than 180 days receivables around INR5 crore; rest mostly within 180 days.
items.quote: Regarding aging, more than 180 days would be around INR5 crores and rest would mostly be within 180 days.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents around INR67.13 crore; other non-current assets around INR16.22 crore; unutilized IPO proceeds INR36.91 crore.
items.quote: If you look at our cash and cash equivalents, it's around INR67.13 crores and other non-current assets is around INR16.22 crores.

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative due to tax payments and inventory buildup; pre-tax operating cash flow was INR3 crores this year versus INR7 crores last year
items.quote: Pre-tax free cash flow will be positive because if you will see there is an inventory of around INR20 crores at the March, okay. So, it will get sold mostly in the April, okay. So, this cash flow will be -- just a moment. Yes. So, inventory will be positive.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance is less than INR5 crores; company has both long-term and short-term loans but does not intend to raise more equity or debt for growth
items.quote: if I just look at your balance sheet, the cash levels are, I think, it's less than INR5 crores if I'm not wrong, and you have, both I think long-term loans and short-term loans.

items.statement: Loans on asset side of INR13.8 crores comprise advance for property purchase, security deposits, and advances to employees
items.quote: So, it's advance for the property purchase and some is security deposit and some is advance to employees.

items.statement: Net cash flow from operating activities turned positive at INR4.7 crores versus negative INR1.425 crores in FY25
items.quote: Net cash flow from the operating activities stood at INR4.7 crores positive compared to negative INR1.425 crores in FY2024-25.

items.statement: Working capital days expanded due to project delays in AV business preventing invoicing and commissioning
items.quote: So, because of that reason, because we already supplied and we did not raise our invoices because the commissioning is not happening because our order, most of the time is including the SITC, which 1s supply, installation, testing, and commissioning, all the four sectors

items.statement: IPO raised INR31.39 cr, nearly fully utilized with only 0.5% (INR15-20 lakh) pending
items.quote: Company has approximately raised INR31.39 crores through the IPO proceeding. And most of them are already used for the purpose of which we have raised the money. On a very, very small amount, because of some materials are too rich, that is pending. And that is also going to be utilized very soon, which is maybe 0.5% of the entire amount.

items.statement: XDuce Infotech acquired 25% stake from promoters at market value
items.quote: We had strategically aligned with XDuce Infotech, which is U.S.-based IT service company, and they acquired 25% stake of the company through market value from promoters.

items.statement: UCI New York signed shareholding agreement to acquire 25% stake in UCI
items.quote: UCI have signed recently. This is not in FY26, but this is just last month, we signed a shareholding agreement with UCI New York that they will be acquiring a 25% stake in UCI.

items.statement: Board approved transfer of Talligence and product businesses to Technosys Private Limited for INR11.90 crores cash
items.quote: The Board approved the transfer of Talligence and product businesses to Technosys Private Limited for cash consideration of approximately INR11.90 crores.

items.statement: Continued investing in people through ESOP initiatives
items.quote: Additionally, we continued investing in our people through employee stock ownership, ESOP, initiatives, reinforcing our commitment to attract, retain and reward high-quality talent.

items.statement: Trade receivables rose to Rs 205 crore because most sales occurred in March; only 3-5% over 6 months excluding retention
items.quote: Actually, as we have told you, that maximum deliveries of goods were... happened in the month of March because of the issues pertaining through October, when we are talking about H2. So, maximum billing of supply of material happened in the month of March, and you never get money just after the supply.

items.statement: Other current assets of Rs 58 crore represent retention money tied up in government projects
items.quote: So, this other current asset is the retention amount, which is basically tied up with the government projects.

items.statement: Management expects positive operating cash flow in FY27 by selecting projects based on bottom line and cash flows
items.quote: And yes, of course, we see a positive cash flow, because as I told earlier that this, the last year is a learning year for us. And, we have also... I, I had said that now, we will be not focusing only on revenue or top line, rather we'll be selecting the projects based on the bottom line and the cash flows.

items.statement: Promoter family may buy shares in coming months as stock is down over 75%
items.quote: Definitely, you will see in coming months, huh? You might see in coming months.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance of INR 2,434 lakh at end of FY26 with virtually debt-free balance sheet
items.quote: We ended financial year 2026 with net worth of INR3,751 lakh, cash and bank balance of INR2,434 lakh, and a virtually debt-free balance sheet.

items.statement: Inventory days improved from 150 to 130 days; focused on receivables collection and took client advances against bank guarantees to improve cash flow cycle
items.quote: Our inventory levels improved from 150 days last year to 130 days currently. We have focused more on the collection of receivables and improved our trade payables by providing advances to secure price benefits.

items.statement: Internal goal to reduce inventory days to 90-100 days; using TReDS, bill discounting, LC limits and client advances against bank guarantees to improve working capital
items.quote: We improved from 160 days last year to 130 days in FY25. Our internal goal is 90 to 100 days. However, because we do custom fabrication, the inventory will always be slightly higher.

items.statement: Future expansion beyond FY27 to reach 800-1000 crore revenue will be funded through internal accruals and equity
items.quote: This would be funded through internal accruals and equity.
